notes: PdfDocument::new, one PdfPage of A4 per input page with its operations: SetFont(Builtin Helvetica, 10 pt), then per text StartTextSection, SetTextCursor, ShowText, EndTextSection, and a DrawLine per rule; with_pages(...).save(&PdfSaveOptions::default()); returns the bytes. default-features = false (the default feature is the HTML layout engine, which the task does not use); default save options (streams compressed).
